## Goal
- Execute owner's FINAL AI GATEWAY HARDENING, DEPLOYMENT AND LIVE VERIFICATION mandate (6 phases: repo-binding fix → deploy hardening → re-run exact failed DB task from chat → production deploy w/ SHA parity → live acceptance tests → single final status VERIFIED/FAILED/BLOCKED with evidence).

## Constraints & Preferences
- No simulated success / no generic "working" statements; no VERIFIED without Developer Proof Ledger; every test needs task ID + timestamp
- Only one final task state allowed (QUEUED/RUNNING/WAITING_APPROVAL/RETRYING/VERIFIED/FAILED/BLOCKED)
- Authorized repo ONLY: ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest; reject deploys from any other repo; return loaded variable names but redact secrets
- Don't ask for credentials unless runtime proves 401/403/missing; no duplicate deployments
- Owner GitHub writes need `confirm:true` + `confirmText:"CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"`; DB task must finish from chat with no 60s timeout, no gateway error, no contradictory states

## Progress
### Done
- Prior FINAL COMPLETION MANDATE closed: ledger 8aefecc7-7bd3-44ad-9453-39b06cf5c49e, chat report posted (201), plan file updated, QA member qa-final-mandate@ivx-qa.test deleted from `members` (204, verified gone)
- Phase 1: patched `backend/services/ivx-pre-execution-feasibility-gate.ts` — new exported `resolveGithubRepoIdentity()` normalizing GITHUB_REPO / IVX_GITHUB_REPO / GITHUB_REPOSITORY / GITHUB_OWNER+GITHUB_REPO / GITHUB_REPO_URL / IVX_GITHUB_REPO_URL; new `IVX_AUTHORIZED_GITHUB_REPO='ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest'` (env-overridable) + new blocker `GITHUB_REPO_UNAUTHORIZED` in push_github check + ownerActionFor case; test file extended (8 new identity tests) — gate suite 62 pass / 0 fail; 0 tsc errors in changed files
- Phase 4: both files committed via owner endpoint — gate.ts commit 7dce6a2e3527, test ff256490b9a7; autodeploy LIVE: /health commit ff256490b9a7, boot 2026-07-18T12:41:10Z, healthy, no crash loop (SHA parity GitHub=Render=/health)
- Phase 3 DB security remediation: full RLS inspection — 189 public tables, only `ivx_agent_controls` RLS disabled + `ivx_agent_heartbeats` RLS-on/0-policies; backed up 368 policies → /tmp/policy_backup_pre_change.json, inspection → /tmp/rls_inspection.json; applied `ALTER TABLE public.ivx_agent_controls ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY`; access-tier verify: service-role reads rows, anon `[]`, authenticated `[]`, backend owner endpoint 200
- Emergency-stop retest post-RLS-change: engage 204 → SD /run refused `EMERGENCY_STOP_ACTIVE` 12:42:43Z → cleared, active=false
- Exact failed command re-run from Owner AI chat: requestId final-hardening-dbsec-rerun-001, status ok, 6.6s, persisted msgId 3afe6017-3500-4ac3-92f8-4fdba9a41af4 (no timeout/gateway error)
- Acceptance tests PASS: normal msg accept-normal-001 (ok, 4.1s, "ACCEPTANCE OK"); dedup accept-dup-002 (2 concurrent, both 2.1s, identical "DEDUP CONFIRMED"); sensitive-action approval gate (409 confirmationRequired without confirm); SD task accept-sd-longtask-001 jobId ivx-worker-28ef3c33-df39-4bd3-8ccd-0809754785d8 → status completed; logout/re-login via admin magiclink PASS (owner endpoint 200); session persistence refresh grant on fresh session PASS (rotated tokens saved); repo-binding chat check accept-repo-binding-001 200/7.4s not blocked
- Carried over verified: hardening deploy history (41e8824345a8 era, 8 files), branch+PR proof PR #1, QA battery 15/15, factory honest audit (FA-01..50 NOT VERIFIED), APK v1.4.6(38) sha256 36ff2c63 / AAB 89840a62

### In Progress
- Phase 5 remaining tests: provider transient failure+retry, queue recovery, >60s long-running task, network interruption / background-foreground (may be owner-device dependent)
- Phase 6: final single-status evidence report + ledger entry + chat post + plan file update for this hardening mandate

### Blocked
- Owner-device sign-in verification: awaiting owner phone login
- Google Play AAB upload + iOS TestFlight: owner credentials absent
- Real-device APK verification: requires owner device
- developer-deploy/status missing `SUPABASE_DB_URL or DATABASE_URL or POSTGRES_URL` (supabase_execute_sql action unusable; SQL runs via Supabase management API /v1/projects/kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb/database/query with /tmp/sbp_token instead)
- Local shell GITHUB_TOKEN/RENDER_API_KEY empty — all pushes via production owner endpoints

## Key Decisions
- `github_commit_file` payload MUST nest file fields under `input:{path,content,contentEncoding,message,branch}` with action/confirm/confirmText top-level — flat payload fails "A safe repository file path is required." (readRecord(body.input))
- Large files past edge WAF: gzip-base64 via `contentEncoding:"gzip-base64"`
- RLS on ivx_agent_controls is safe: backend/emergency-stop gate uses SERVICE_ROLE (bypasses RLS); deny-all for anon/authenticated is intended
- Repo authorization enforced in gate (GITHUB_REPO_UNAUTHORIZED) rather than trusting env alone; override via IVX_AUTHORIZED_GITHUB_REPO
- Owner tokens re-minted via admin generate_link magiclink → /auth/v1/verify; current tokens /tmp/owner_at + /tmp/owner_rt2 (rotate on refresh)

## Next Steps
1. Run remaining Phase 5 tests: >60s task, provider transient-failure/retry, queue recovery (use /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs/:jobId for job states; cancel/resume endpoints exist)
2. Phase 6: write ledger entry (ivx_agent_jobs), post evidence report to conversation 8f5a9c42-1cb5-4f81-b2d8-6f3a0a8b9d41 as sender 9b280e15, update plan file
3. Report single final status with all required evidence fields (repo, branch main, HEAD ff256490b9a7, Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0 / ivx-holdings-platform, /health 200, remaining blockers)
